A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a strong effect of preview on skipping, that there is full word recognition in the parafovea, and that skipping is based on partial word information.

there are 4 types of skipping, each based on a different level of information: (1) skipping of a word that has been fully identified in the parafovea; (2) skipping of a nonword that is similar to the target; (3) skipping of a visually similar word that is not the target; and (4) skipping of a target word that has not been identified in the para-fovea.

there are 3 types of skipping, and the skipping rate for a given target word depends on the combination of the type of skipping and the type of preview.
